methodology.single_node: Run one llama-server instance on one ARM node with the three mandatory prompts.
methodology.scalability: Vary thread count on one node and, when requested with sbatch --nodes, run one independent server replica per node. This is service-level replica scaling, not tensor/pipeline parallelism.
methodology.statistics: Use 3 trials for the initial benchmark because the prompt set is intentionally small.
methodology.warmup: Start the server, wait for /health, then use repeated trials to reduce first-run noise.

initial_simple_profile.prompts: Only the 3 mandatory prompts from the PDF
